# The Art Institute of Chicago

> > World-renowned art museum in Chicago featuring 5,000 years of art from Van Gogh, Picasso, Warhol, and more, with extensive educational programs and public events.

The Art Institute of Chicago offers a comprehensive collection spanning ancient to contemporary art, housed in venues including the Modern Wing, Griffin Court, and Rubloff Auditorium. The museum provides diverse programming through the Ryan Learning Center, Woman's Board initiatives, and community partnerships, with special emphasis on accessible art education and live performances.

- [Discover Art & Artists](https://www.artic.edu/collection): Browse 5,000 years of art by Van Gogh, Picasso, Warhol & more

## Gallery Talks & Tours

- [Gallery Talk: Mammals in Art](https://www.artic.edu/events/4261/gallery-talk-mammals-in-art): Guided tour exploring mammals in art led by Sam Anderson-Ramos
- [Gallery Talk: Patience—The Rewards of Looking Longer](https://www.artic.edu/events/4329/gallery-talk-patiencethe-rewards-of-looking-longer): Slow-looking gallery tour featuring Brice Marden's work
- [Express Talk: Zapata Was Here](https://www.artic.edu/events/4200/express-talk-zapata-was-here): 30-min tour of Orozco's Zapata from Winterbotham Collection
- [Express Talk: Time-Based Media](https://www.artic.edu/events/4206/express-talk-time-based-media-2): 30-min curatorial talk on time-based media preservation with Solveig Nelson
- [Express Talk: Connecting Past and Present](https://www.artic.edu/events/4211/express-talk-connecting-past-and-present): 30-min tour featuring Tanner's Two Disciples at the Tomb

## Concerts & Performances

- [Concert: William Basinski—Disintegration Loops with the Chicago Philharmonic](https://www.artic.edu/events/4343/concert-william-basinskidisintegration-loops-with-the-chicago-philharmonic): Basinski's Disintegration Loops performed by Chicago Philharmonic
- [Concert: Haley Fohr](https://www.artic.edu/events/4389/concert-haley-fohr-3): Midwinter concert by Haley Fohr on Grand Staircase
- [Concert: Arto Lindsay with Beauty Pill](https://www.artic.edu/events/3313/concert-arto-lindsay-with-beauty-pill): No Wave pioneer Arto Lindsay performs with Beauty Pill

## Educational Programs & Workshops

- [Art Insights: Pablo Picasso: In His Own Words](https://www.artic.edu/events/4025/art-insights-pablo-picasso-in-his-own-words): Community program on Picasso for older adults with Dick Wright
- [Beginners Sketching Workshop](https://www.artic.edu/events/4559/beginners-sketching-workshop-4559): One-day sketching workshop led by Barbara Fitzpatrick
- [Open Studio: Printmaking](https://www.artic.edu/events/3959/open-studio-printmaking-3959): Hands-on printmaking workshop inspired by Helen Frankenthaler
- [Encounters with Asia: The Art of Place—Contemporary Asian Art Destinations](https://www.artic.edu/events/4291/encounters-with-asia): Asian Art Council lecture series on contemporary Asian art destinations

## Family & Community Programs

- [Picture This](https://www.artic.edu/events/3857/picture-this-3857): Family storytelling program for children 18mo-3yrs in galleries
- [King Day Festival: Long Journey into Freedom](https://www.artic.edu/events/4216/king-day-festival-long-journey-into-freedom): Free MLK Day festival with art activities and Dawoud Bey exhibition
- [Art Institute Block Party](https://www.artic.edu/events/3872/art-institute-block-party): 12-hour 125th anniversary celebration with art, performances & community

## Optional

- [Screening and Discussion: Pope.L—The Escape](https://www.artic.edu/events/4082/screening-and-discussion-popelthe-escape): Pope.L film screening and discussion on abolitionist history
- [Gallery Activation: Drop-In Experience](https://www.artic.edu/events/4396/gallery-activation-drop-in-experience): Interactive sound composition drop-in by Wong & Hapke in Gallery 50
- [East Community Associates: There's Art in Iceland?](https://www.artic.edu/events/4124/east-community-associates-theres-art-in-iceland): Members-only lecture on Icelandic art at Munster Center
- [CANCELED | Conversation: Bullets and Steel—The Making of Elizabethan Armor](https://www.artic.edu/events/4191/canceled-conversation-bullets-and-steelthe-making-of-elizabethan-armor): Canceled lecture on experimental Elizabethan armor reconstruction
